correctness.rationale: Direct reconstruction verifies the exact five-element poset orders, 20 free off-diagonal bits, reflexivity, all 125 transitivity triples and both 4-quantifier Fischer–Servi witness laws. A newly implemented C checker represents R with five 5-bit row masks, checks R^2⊆R and both witness clauses independently of the submitted file, and enumerates all 1,048,576 off-diagonal assignments per poset. It reproduces M3=1395 and N5=1079, endpoint partitions [870,262,262,1] and [618,230,230,1]. For the six S3 permutations of M3 middle points it obtains identity=1395, each transposition=199, each 3-cycle=27; Burnside gives (1395+3·199+2·27)/6=341. The N5 order automorphism is trivial because its two atoms have inequivalent upper-chain structures. For any bounded P, 4R0 plus FS1 gives xR0 for all x; 0R4 plus FS2 gives 0Rz for all z; transitivity then forces universal R. Converse is immediate. This is an exact finite certificate plus a separate all-poset proof, not an infinite extrapolation.
residual_risks: No formal proof assistant is claimed; independently exhaustively enumerated finite cases and proved the general endpoint lemma logically.

value.rationale: M3 and N5 are precisely the minimal modular/nonmodular nondistributive obstruction pair, giving strong intrinsic motivation to compare Fischer–Servi-compatible reflexive/transitive relations on their smallest labelled carriers. The exact complete census, all automorphism classes, and the two endpoint-edge stratifications are independent natural finite semantic invariants, not a randomly chosen numerical slice; they make concrete test instances for studying dual/modal frame constructions. The companion endpoint universality lemma identifies a structural boundary valid on arbitrary bounded posets. These facts are neither a renaming nor a textbook consequence of the frame-definition axioms, and no claim to model-theoretic completeness or a paper-size contribution is needed.
residual_risks: The exact finite census has narrower downstream implications than a general completeness theorem.
The universality lemma is elementary; mathematical value depends primarily on the motivated complete classification and symmetry/endpoint strata.
